questions.text: An ECOSYSTEM includes ___
options: only the animals in an area
only the plants in an area
all the living AND nonliving things in an area interacting together
only the weather in an area
questions.answer: all the living AND nonliving things in an area interacting together

questions.text: PRODUCERS in a food web are organisms that ___
options: make their own food using sunlight (plants)
questions.answer: make their own food using sunlight (plants)

questions.text: DECOMPOSERS like bacteria and fungi are important because they ___
options: break down dead organisms and return nutrients to the soil
questions.answer: break down dead organisms and return nutrients to the soil

questions.text: Energy flows through a food web from ___
options: producers to consumers (sun → plants → herbivores → carnivores)
questions.answer: producers to consumers (sun → plants → herbivores → carnivores)

questions.text: PHOTOSYNTHESIS can be summarized as: Plants use sunlight + water + carbon dioxide to make ___
questions.answer: glucose (sugar) and oxygen

questions.text: What happens to most of the energy as it passes from one level of a food chain to the next?
options: It is lost as heat, so less energy is available at each higher level
It all gets stored in the top predator
questions.answer: It is lost as heat, so less energy is available at each higher level

questions.text: LANDFORMS are features of Earth's surface. Which landform is formed by a river depositing sediment at its mouth where it meets the ocean?
questions.answer: Delta

questions.text: EROSION is different from WEATHERING because erosion ___
options: moves and carries away weathered material
questions.answer: moves and carries away weathered material

questions.text: What can FARMERS do to help prevent soil EROSION on their land?
options: Remove all trees and plants near fields
Plant cover crops and use terracing on slopes
Leave all soil bare between growing seasons
questions.answer: Plant cover crops and use terracing on slopes

questions.text: The FORCE OF GRAVITY on Earth pulls all objects ___
options: in the direction they are moving
questions.answer: downward toward Earth's center

questions.text: An object in MOTION will continue moving at the same speed and direction UNLESS ___
options: an unbalanced force acts on it
questions.answer: an unbalanced force acts on it

questions.text: CONDUCTION is the transfer of heat through ___
options: empty space (like sunlight traveling to Earth)
liquids and gases moving in currents
questions.answer: direct contact between objects

questions.text: CONVECTION is the transfer of heat through ___
questions.answer: currents in liquids or gases

questions.text: RADIATION is different from conduction and convection because it ___
options: requires direct contact to transfer heat
requires a medium (liquid or gas) to transfer heat
can transfer heat through empty space without needing matter
questions.answer: can transfer heat through empty space without needing matter

questions.text: The SUN is the primary source of energy for Earth. Without the Sun, most life on Earth ___
options: could not survive because plants could not photosynthesize
questions.answer: could not survive because plants could not photosynthesize

questions.text: PHYSICAL PROPERTIES of matter include ___
options: how the matter reacts with other substances
color, mass, volume, texture, and state (solid/liquid/gas)
whether it can burn or rust
what it is made of at the atomic level
questions.answer: color, mass, volume, texture, and state (solid/liquid/gas)

questions.text: A CHEMICAL CHANGE is different from a physical change because in a chemical change ___
options: the shape of the object changes
a new substance with different properties is formed
the size of the object changes
questions.answer: a new substance with different properties is formed

questions.text: Which is an example of a CHEMICAL CHANGE?
options: A log burning in a fire
questions.answer: A log burning in a fire

questions.text: ORGANISMS in the same ECOSYSTEM compete for ___
options: exactly the same amount of sunlight every day
limited resources like food, water, space, and shelter
the same prey as all other organisms
no resources because nature provides for all
questions.answer: limited resources like food, water, space, and shelter

questions.text: Which is the best example of a MUTUALISTIC relationship (both organisms benefit)?
options: A tick taking blood from a dog
A bee collecting nectar from a flower while spreading pollen
A tree blocking sunlight from smaller plants
questions.answer: A bee collecting nectar from a flower while spreading pollen
